stem: Cascade Biotech's new manufacturing site must move large CAD files to AWS daily, and its network engineer has told leadership the link needs a bandwidth guarantee and none of that traffic can cross the public internet.

choices.text: Order a dedicated AWS Direct Connect connection sized for the daily transfer volume
Establish a Site-to-Site VPN connection over the site's existing internet circuit
Send the CAD files to an S3 bucket over the public internet with TLS
Attach a Transit Gateway VPN attachment to the manufacturing site's router

rationale: A dedicated Direct Connect connection provides a guaranteed-bandwidth, private path that bypasses the public internet. A Site-to-Site VPN, whether standalone or attached to a Transit Gateway, still carries traffic over the public internet even though it is encrypted. Sending files to S3 over the internet with TLS also crosses the public internet and offers no bandwidth guarantee.
